name: RFHW Extreme Championship
epitaph: Contested in barbed-wire deathmatches from the wing's own founding; Hayabusa won it from Rick Taylor in a Barbed Wire Thumbtack Deathmatch at the wing's only held show, Clash Of The Champions, with the broadcast's own commentary crediting Taylor as the belt's first-ever holder. No further reign survives.
notes: A companion TV Championship and World Championship are also named on this show's own card but neither title change is asserted -- see this wing's own show notes.
